title: Nashville Serenity Spot|HotTub, Sauna & ColdPlunge
description:
Experience true luxury and wellness in this exclusive Nashville townhome. This fully furnished, high-end retreat features four spacious private en-suite bedrooms, sophisticated modern design, and a beautifully curated open-concept living space made for comfort and connection. Indulge in resort-style amenities including a private sauna, cold plunge, and a rooftop hot tub offering breathtaking skyline views. Every detail is thoughtfully designed to deliver a five-star stay.

The space
Luxury Townhome with Rooftop Hot Tub, Cold Plunge & Sauna

Discover your fully furnished, high-end townhome just minutes from downtown Nashville. Designed for both style and comfort, this stunning retreat features four spacious bedrooms, each with a private en-suite bathroom—perfect for families, groups, or friends traveling together.

Inside, enjoy sleek modern finishes, a cozy fireplace, and an open-concept layout ideal for relaxing or entertaining. Indulge in premium wellness amenities, including a private sauna, cold plunge, and a rooftop hot tub with breathtaking panoramic views of the Nashville skyline.

Every detail is curated to provide an elevated experience, combining luxury, convenience, and unforgettable city vistas. Whether you’re exploring Music City or simply looking to unwind in style, this unique townhome offers the perfect backdrop for an unforgettable stay.

Guest access
You have access to the entirety of the home!

Other things to note
While the neighborhood is generally quiet and safe, it’s important to remember that this is an urban environment. We encourage you to stay mindful of your surroundings and practice common sense. For your safety, we recommend not leaving valuables in your car and ensuring that doors and windows are securely locked whenever you leave the house.
